test_transform_scalers: test gradient transformation scalers including adam, rmsprop, lion, adadelta, and polyak
test_transform_apply_every: test the apply_every transform that delays parameter updates to run every k steps
test_transform_scale: test the scale transform that multiplies updates by a configurable factor
test_transform_centralize: test the centralize transform that subtracts the mean from each array
test_transform_scale_by_optimistic_gradi: test the scale_by_optimistic_gradient transform that uses previous gradients for lookahead updates
